actions.name: Responsibility Centers
actions.caption: Responsibility Centers
actions.tooltip: Set up responsibility centers to administer business operations that cover multiple locations, such as a sales offices or a purchasing departments.

actions.name: Report Layouts
actions.caption: Report Layouts
actions.tooltip: Specify the layout to use on reports when viewing, printing, and saving them. The layout defines things like text font, field placement, or background.

actions.name: General Ledger Setup
actions.caption: General Ledger Setup
actions.tooltip: Define your general accounting policies, such as the allowed posting period and how payments are processed. Set up your default dimensions for financial analysis.

actions.name: Sales & Receivables Setup
actions.caption: Sales & Receivables Setup
actions.tooltip: Define your general policies for sales invoicing and returns, such as when to show credit and stockout warnings and how to post sales discounts. Set up your number series for creating customers and different sales documents.

actions.name: Purchases & Payables Setup
actions.caption: Purchases & Payables Setup
actions.tooltip: Define your general policies for purchase invoicing and returns, such as whether to require vendor invoice numbers and how to post purchase discounts. Set up your number series for creating vendors and different purchase documents.

actions.name: Inventory Setup
actions.caption: Inventory Setup
actions.tooltip: Define your general inventory policies, such as whether to allow negative inventory and how to post and adjust item costs. Set up your number series for creating new inventory items or services.

actions.name: Fixed Assets Setup
actions.caption: Fixed Assets Setup
actions.tooltip: Define your accounting policies for fixed assets, such as the allowed posting period and whether to allow posting to main assets. Set up your number series for creating new fixed assets.

actions.name: Human Resources Setup
actions.caption: Human Resources Setup
actions.tooltip: Set up number series for creating new employee cards and define if employment time is measured by days or hours.

actions.name: Jobs Setup
actions.caption: Projects Setup
actions.tooltip: Define your accounting policies for projects, such as which WIP method to use and whether to update project item costs automatically.

actions.name: No. Series
actions.caption: No. Series
actions.tooltip: Set up the number series from which a new number is automatically assigned to new cards and documents, such as item cards and sales invoices.

actions.name: Users
actions.caption: Users
actions.tooltip: Set up the employees who will work in this company.

actions.name: Permission Sets
actions.caption: Permission Sets
actions.tooltip: View or edit which feature objects that users need to access and set up the related permissions in permission sets that you can assign to the users of the database.

actions.name: Action27
actions.caption: Currencies
actions.tooltip: Set up the different currencies that you trade in by defining which general ledger accounts the involved transactions are posted to and how the foreign currency amounts are rounded.

actions.name: Countries/Regions
actions.caption: Countries/Regions
actions.tooltip: Set up the country/regions where your different business partners are located, so that you can assign Country/Region codes to business partners where special local procedures are required.

actions.name: Post Codes
actions.caption: Post Codes
actions.tooltip: Set up the post codes of cities where your business partners are located.

actions.name: Online Map Setup
actions.caption: Online Map Setup
actions.tooltip: Define which map provider to use and how routes and distances are displayed when you choose the Online Map field on business documents.

actions.name: Languages
actions.caption: Languages
actions.tooltip: Set up the languages that are spoken by your different business partners, so that you can print item names or descriptions in the relevant language.

actions.name: Source Codes
actions.caption: Source Codes
actions.tooltip: Set up codes for your different types of business transactions, so that you can track the source of the transactions in an audit.

actions.name: Reason Codes
actions.caption: Reason Codes
actions.tooltip: View or set up codes that specify reasons why entries were created, such as Return, to specify why a purchase credit memo was posted.

controls.name: AmountOnOutstandingInvoices

controls.name: AmountOnOutstandingCrMemos
controls.tooltip: Specifies your refunds to the customer in the current fiscal year based on ongoing sales credit memos. The figure in parenthesis shows the number of ongoing sales credit memos.

controls.name: Totals

controls.name: CustInvDiscAmountLCY

controls.name: InteractionCount

controls.name: LastInteractionDate

controls.name: LastInteractionType

controls.name: VAT Due Sales
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT due on sales and other outputs. This corresponds to box 1 on the VAT Return form.

controls.name: VAT Due Acquisitions
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT due on acquisitions from other EC Member States. This corresponds to box 2 on the VAT Return form.

controls.name: Total VAT Due
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total VAT due (the sum of "VAT Due Sales" and "VAT Due Acquisitions"). This corresponds to box 3 on the VAT Return form.

controls.name: VAT Reclaimed Curr Period
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT reclaimed on purchases and other inputs (including acquisitions from the EC). This corresponds to box 4 on the VAT Return form.

controls.name: Net VAT Due
controls.tooltip: Specifies the difference between "Total VAT Due" and "VAT Reclaimed Curr Period". This corresponds to box 5 on the VAT Return form.

controls.name: Total Value Sales Excl. VAT
controls.tooltip: Specifies the yotal value of sales and all other outputs excluding any VAT. This corresponds to box 6 on the VAT Return form.

controls.name: Total Value Purchases Excl.VAT
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of purchases and all other inputs excluding any VAT (including exempt purchases). This corresponds to box 7 on the VAT Return form.

controls.name: Total Value Goods Suppl. ExVAT
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of all supplies of goods and related costs, excluding any VAT, to other EC member states. This corresponds to box 8 on the VAT Return form.

controls.name: Total Acquisitions Excl. VAT
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of acquisitions of goods and related costs excluding any VAT, from other EC member states. This corresponds to box 9 on the VAT Return form.
